verdict.rationale: Gitea's own marketing page lists "SAML SSO Integration" as a feature, apparently as part of a tiered or managed offering. That counts as a documented first-party capability, but the only evidence is a bare feature-list mention. The OAuth2 and OIDC-provider mentions from the community cover a different capability and are not credited. Missing for 10: documentation of SAML configuration, the ability to enforce or require SAML for an organization (blocking non-SSO logins), clarity on which edition or tier includes it, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
